headline: Renesas posts senior verification roles for automotive PMIC RNM/AMS environments
fact: Renesas posted related Senior Principal roles for Automotive PMIC verification, covering RNM/AMS model integration, RTL-to-GLS correlation, PVT analysis, switched-mode regulators/LDOs, cross-team handoffs and methodology leadership. A related Staff Verification Engineer description, rechecked October 6, 2026, also requires PMIC RNM/AMS environment architecture and Verilog/SystemVerilog proficiency, alongside GLS correlation and analog/digital interaction debugging. These related senior recruitment requirements are grouped without treating a different job title as a separate technical adoption milestone or changing the original Event date.
